engines.name: pdfrum
engines.note: the facade with default features: Document::open, Page::render_on with VelloCpuBackend, Page::text_on

engines.name: hayro
engines.note: hayro_syntax::Pdf::new, hayro::render with RenderCache held warm; no text API

engines.name: hayro-interpret
engines.note: no text API: the harness implements a Device whose draw_glyph collects Glyph::as_unicode in draw order, newline on baseline change (harness-assembled, see README)

engines.name: lopdf
engines.note: Document::load_mem then every object visited; extract_text(&[1])

engines.name: pdf
engines.note: FileOptions::cached().open, every page's resources loaded; no text or render API (pdf_render is a separate, commercial crate)

engines.name: pdf_oxide
engines.note: PdfDocument::open, rendering::render_page at the run's DPI as RawRgba8, extract_text(0)

engines.name: mupdf
engines.note: Document::open, Page::to_pixmap(scale matrix, DeviceRGB, show_extras), Page::text(default options); built with default-features = false + base14-fonts
